decisions.note: A video game feature highlights various fictional brands within GTA 6.

digest:
- Progressive launched Snapshot Pro, allowing commercial fleets to use their own eligible telematics devices or insurer hardware, increasing competition for Nirvana in the telematics-driven last-mile segment [1].
- Carriers are increasingly demanding full on-demand visibility and audit-ready data from MGAs holding capacity, validating Nirvana's live telematics data capabilities [4].
- Royal Mail forecasts record parcel volumes and scales operations with 22,000 seasonal workers, increasing last-mile fleet exposure and highlighting the need for real-time telematics oversight [2, 3].
